mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous two months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points over the previous month signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS increases by more than 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies struggle with production and supply chain issues.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 0.5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is above 2% annualized, the combination signals an environment of low rates with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) over three consecutive months signals a strong labor market, which leads to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases over three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When Housing Starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% month-over-month and Real GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter, the combined signal indicates a strong demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increase > 5% MoM and GDPC1 increase > 2% QoQ
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases by more than 5% MoM and GDPC1 increases by more than 2% QoQ.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25 percentage points in a month signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 0.25pp in a month.
